fusions.name: Gnawing Pulse
fusions.desc: Sends a gnawing strand at the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Cargo Plague
fusions.desc: Coughs a cloud of foul strands across a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 poison damage and leaving each enemy [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bilge Recovery
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you, with a 10% chance to critically heal. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Tressrat Brood
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded rat of your own hair that fights beside you, gnawing enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Diseased] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
